name: Keycast
author: rewuschel
description: Keycaster overlay with two layouts: a stream of keys and shortcuts for screencasts, and a gamer board (WASD cluster, mouse, KPS/APM) that lights every held key. Reads keys locally through Hyprland or /dev/input; keys are never saved or sent anywhere.

barWidget.description: On-screen keycaster: stream and gamer layouts, style, size, position, privacy
